prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: fixed-background 2D RPG environment for a playable micro-node
Input images: Image 1 is the source-video composition reference; Image 2 is the accepted piazza's palette, pixel treatment, architectural material, and mountain-depth style reference only.
Primary request: Recreate Image 1 as a clean, unoccupied Appennino hill-town belvedere that can serve as the next playable node after the piazza.
Scene/backdrop: layered green Apennine valley and distant mountains under a bright pale-blue sky; a small church and fields far below; terracotta village roofs and the bell tower visible beyond the right parapet.
Subject: a compact stone-paved overlook terrace occupying the lower third, with a broad clear walkable surface from an entrance at bottom center to a viewpoint near center; low stone parapet along the left, front, and right edges; modest foliage only at the extreme lower corners.
Style/medium: polished hand-painted pixel-art RPG background matching Image 2's warm limestone, terracotta, restrained outlines, soft atmospheric depth, and readable cobblestone scale.
Composition/framing: 16:9 landscape, fixed camera, same elevated RPG viewing language as Image 2; preserve Image 1's valley-view composition but remove its player and interface. Keep the terrace geometry visually simple and collision-readable. The bottom-center entrance must remain visibly open and unobstructed.
Lighting/mood: clear warm daylight, tranquil and inviting.
Constraints: no people, no animals, no dialogue prompt, no HUD, no bars, no coins, no letters, no text, no icons, no watermark; no stairs; no market props; no foreground object crossing the bottom-center entrance; do not copy Image 2's piazza layout or fountain.
